articles.title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
articles.description:
Boston is in the midst of another winning streak. The club has won nine straight games.

The post Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1 appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Red Sox defeated the Athletics 13-1, extending their winning streak to nine games.
Pitcher Payton Tolle recorded 14 strikeouts, showcasing his dominance on the mound.
Boston residents can celebrate the team's strong performance as playoff hopes increase.
